# Inspecto LA — brochure

<!-- generated by tools/render-product-docs.mjs from products/la.toon and the hubs it links; never edit it: change the definition or those hubs, then run the tool -->

*Audience: customers, presales and sales. Prices are not published here. Product Map Item [`product.la`](index.md) · a Domain product.*

> **Find the links between entities in your data: explore them as a graph, place them on a map, and keep lists of the ones that matter.**

## What it is

Explore who is connected to whom, investigate a number, and build a Dossier you can stand behind.

## Apps

- **[Link Analysis](../../app/link-analysis/index.md)** (required) — Investigate how entities link, one expand step at a time. Your Datasets: add files, see what arrived, and choose how each is read as a graph. Place entities and routes on a map, over any Dataset with coordinates. See what the data says about each Entity Type and each Entity: how many, where, how fresh. Keep watch lists of entities, with every change on the record. See fired Alerts, and open the Investigation behind a standing detection.
